problem: Premarket heartbeat v2.1 reused first-seen/first-change/peak state from the prior day's premarket-hot.json whenever the same ticker appeared again. That polluted Persistence Slope, first-detection timing and peak-memory across trading sessions, creating a cross-session state leak.

evidenceBefore.source: TAGX premarket hot heartbeat event-driven v2.1
evidenceBefore.stateReuseRule: oldrows[ticker] reused without checking ET session date
evidenceBefore.risk: A ticker recurring on the next trading day could inherit yesterday's firstAHSeenUTC/firstAHChangePct/peakAHChangePct and distort early-capture/persistence evaluation.

details: Added sessionDateET as an explicit event-state partition key.
Prior per-ticker state is reusable only when prior sessionDateET equals the current ET date.
Legacy files without sessionDateET are date-resolved from updatedAtET before reuse.
Fallback retention is disabled across an ET session boundary.
Added firstPMSeenUTC/firstPMChangePct/peakPMChangePct while keeping legacy aliases for compatibility.
Output records priorStateReused so replay/observability can verify state provenance.

benchmark.before: cross-session state could be reused for repeated tickers
benchmark.afterExpected: 0 prior-day first-seen/peak/fallback observations may be reused in the new ET session
benchmark.promotion: production data-correctness fix; no scoring threshold changed
benchmark.nextValidation: Confirm first successful 2026-08-28 premarket snapshot has sessionDateET=2026-08-28 and priorStateReused=false on the first run, then true only for subsequent same-day snapshots.

championChallenger: No champion score/ranking thresholds changed. This is a causal data-boundary correction required before valid Time-to-Detection/Early-Capture measurements.
